name: Stull's Fruit Farm
tagline: Link to Stull's Fruit Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/stullsfruitfarm
description: Stull's Fruit Farm is a berry farm in Cardington, OH. Visitors come for Blueberries, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
